reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing single shouldFillCategory definition that every month-wide action already uses, but setZero re-writes the category query instead of calling getAverageFillCategories.

duplication.why: setZero's new SQL is a verbatim copy of the categories+group join in getAverageFillCategories, which now applies exactly the same filter.

placement.why: The template check and the unified rule live in actions.ts beside shouldFillCategory, the tree's declared single definition; goal_def is added to the data each source query returns.

scope.why: Only the fill rule, its callers' queries and a DB type are touched.

maintainability.why: Removing the per-action hidden modes leaves one simple rule, though the duplicated setZero query and an untested goal_def parse heuristic are small costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the average actions all filter through shouldFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied query in setZero is literal, not disguised.

one_place.where: shouldFillCategory (with hasSavedTemplates) in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and getAverageFillCategories for the 3/6/12-month averages.
